Programme to Support the Health System Strengthening of The Bahamas

description.narrative: El objetivo general es reducir la morbilidad y mortalidad causadas por COVID-19, mitigar los impactos indirectos de la pandemia en el estado de salud de la poblacin y fortalecer la preparacin del sistema de salud de las Bahamas para futuros riesgos de salud.

The overall objective is to reduce the morbidity and mortality caused by COVID-19, mitigate the indirect impacts of the pandemic on the health status of the population, and strengthen the preparedness of the health system of The Bahamas for future health risks.
